items.title_en: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
items.title_zh: Urbex：面向城市级3D场景的智能体空间定位
items.abstract_en: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.
items.abstract_zh: 城市级3D定位通常被建模为候选排序，需要预先计算实例候选框，在大规模户外场景中效率低下。我们提出 Urbex，一个智能体式视觉-语言框架，将定位重新表述为主动空间搜索。Urbex 把城市级3D场景表示为可交互的多视角环境，使 VLM 智能体能够查询地标、放大局部区域、渲染斜视视角，并最终给出定位好的边界框。我们在 CityRefer 上以强化学习优化这一工具使用策略，采用平滑定位奖励与轻量塑形奖励以实现高效探索。实验表明，Urbex 在 CityRefer 上取得最佳 Hit@1 与 IoU，支持无需候选框、无需真值框的定位，且速度显著快于最强的城市级排序基线。在 STPLS3D-Refer 上的零样本结果进一步显示其跨场景鲁棒性有所提升。
items.highlight_zh: 将城市级3D定位重构为智能体主动搜索，免候选框且更快
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：给定一句自然语言描述，在城市级3D场景中找出对应物体的位置。传统做法是先离线算出成千上万个候选实例框、再逐一排序，在户外大场景中既慢又依赖大量预处理。
2）方法：Urbex 换了思路，把定位当作“主动找路”。它把整座城市的3D场景变成一个可交互的多视角环境，让视觉语言模型（VLM）像人一样调用工具：先查询地标、放大某片区域、渲染斜视角，最后确认并输出一个边界框。作者用强化学习训练这套“用工具”的策略，奖励上用平滑的定位奖励配合轻量塑形奖励，让探索更高效。
3）结果：在 CityRefer 数据集上，Urbex 的 Hit@1 和 IoU 均为最好；它不需要预先给定候选框，也不需要真值框；速度明显快于最强的城市级排序基线。迁移到 STPLS3D-Refer 做零样本测试时，跨场景表现也更稳健。
4）意义：这说明“让模型主动搜索”比“排序一堆候选”更适合城市级3D理解，摆脱了对候选生成与真值框的依赖，为大规模户外场景中的智能体式空间推理提供了新范式。

rm.usage: 城市级文本指代式3D场景定位与赛场雷达的全场目标检测/坐标解算不是同一问题，关联很弱；仅“查询地标、放大局部、主动搜索”的智能体式搜索思路或可借鉴到雷达多相机调度，但需大改。

items.title_en: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
items.title_zh: Player-1：从合成经验中学习玩游戏
items.abstract_en: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.
items.abstract_zh: 计算机使用智能体已能解读屏幕并执行键盘鼠标操作，但视觉丰富、机制多样的游戏仍是迈向通用数字控制的高难度一步。现有游戏智能体训练流程依赖覆盖有限的演示数据，可扩展的交互式训练环境也难以获得。我们提出 Player-1：一个通过合成经验在演示之外学习游戏控制的后期训练框架，扩展了动作空间（相对指针移动、持续输入、复合动作），在 6,044 条精选游戏轨迹上做监督初始化，并构建含 16 个 2D 与 3D 合成环境的 Player-1-Gym，用可程序化验证的奖励与随机化的观测和控制动力学进行 PPO 多环境强化学习。Player-1-9B 与 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 上比各自 SFT 策略分别提升 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点；9B 成功率达 38.33%，而最强评测基线仅 12.63%，并在 ViZDoom-10 与 GameWorld 上进一步超越 SFT。
items.highlight_zh: 合成经验强化学习把游戏成功率从12.63%提到38.33%
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：游戏是检验 AI 通用数字控制能力的高难度场景。现有做法主要靠大规模人类演示训练智能体，但演示覆盖的游戏状态有限，很多动态情形根本看不到；而能大规模做交互试错训练的环境又很难搭建，因此智能体一遇到演示之外的情况就容易失败。
2) 方法：作者提出 Player-1 后期训练框架，把“看屏幕、动键鼠”的计算机使用模型迁移到游戏。先扩充动作空间：除点击外还支持相对指针移动、长按持续输入，以及把多个键鼠操作组合起来的复合动作，更贴近真实游玩。再做监督初始化：在 6,044 条人工整理的游玩轨迹上微调，这些轨迹同时标注动作、任务指令与视觉推理。然后自建 Player-1-Gym，含 16 个围绕游戏共通控制需求设计的合成 2D/3D 环境，奖励可程序化自动判定，观测与控制动力学随机化，用于多环境 PPO 强化学习。
3) 结果：Player-1-9B 与 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 上分别比各自的 SFT 初始策略提升 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点；9B 达到 38.33% 成功率，评测中最强基线仅 12.63%；在 ViZDoom-10 和 GameWorld 上也优于 SFT。分析显示，合成环境覆盖越广迁移越好，且训练中复合动作的使用频率上升，说明模型学会了更像人的组合操作。
4) 意义：证明“先用演示初始化、再用合成经验强化”能显著突破演示数据的天花板，为通用游戏与数字操作智能体提供了可复制的训练范式。
items.comment: Project Page: https://player-1-project.github.io/ and code: https://github.com/TencentARC/Player-1

rm.usage: 用合成环境+可程序化验证奖励做 PPO 训练的思路，可借鉴到哨兵/策略的仿真闭环训练，但对象是电脑操作类游戏智能体，与 RoboMaster 视觉自瞄、实车控制差异大，需大量改造。

items.title_en: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
items.title_zh: GreenWAM：面向机器人学的世界基础模型
items.abstract_en: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. As a policy, it scores among the top entries of the RoboTwin 2.0 leaderboard, reaches the highest zero-shot LIBERO-plus success among the compared methods and is competitive with dedicated vision-language-action and world-action policies on CALVIN and LIBERO. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $π_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人既需要一个预测自身动作将如何改变场景的世界模型，也需要一个选择动作的策略。现有模型通常只针对其中一种角色构建与评估，且每个机器人都用自己的格式记录动作。我们追问：一个机器人世界模型能否跨不同本体同时承担这两种角色，以及其成功的关键是什么。我们提出 GreenWAM——一个机器人世界基础模型，并给出其构建配方：（1）共享解剖学动作空间，用统一关节坐标描述从双臂机械臂到灵巧人形共20个机器人家族；（2）在这些家族上以视觉、动作条件和世界-动作三种模式联合训练；（3）从生成器中拆分出动作专家以形成策略。作为世界模型，GreenWAM 在 WorldArena 1.0 上的轨迹、深度与3D精度均达顶尖水平，优于我们对比中的全部世界-动作模型与视频生成器；作为策略，它在 RoboTwin 2.0 排行榜中位居前列，在所比较方法中取得最高的零样本 LIBERO-plus 成功率，并在 CALVIN 与 LIBERO 上与专门的视觉-语言-动作及世界-动作策略相当。我们还将其适配到真实人形机器人，成功率高于由 π0.5 和 Cosmos 3 Edge 适配而来的策略，并将其蒸馏为单步策略以实现实时控制。控制实验得出三点发现：机器人特化能同时改善世界预测与控制；动作专家在适配开始时即拆分更有效；策略适配期间保留世界模型模式有助于维持对场景变化的鲁棒性。
items.highlight_zh: 一个世界模型兼顾预测与策略，跨20种机器人本体通用
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：机器人需要两种能力——世界模型（预测动作会让场景怎么变）和策略（决定该做什么动作）。但现有模型往往只做其中一件事，而且每家的机器人动作记录格式都不同，难以通用。作者追问：一个模型能否跨本体同时做好这两件事？
2）方法：GreenWAM 世界基础模型及其“配方”包含三步：一是共享的解剖学动作空间，用统一关节坐标描述20个机器人家族，从双臂机械臂到灵巧人形；二是在视觉、动作条件、世界-动作三种模式下对这些家族联合训练；三是把动作专家从生成器中拆分出来，形成策略。
3）结果：作为世界模型，GreenWAM 在 WorldArena 1.0 上的轨迹、深度和3D精度都属顶级，超过对比中的世界-动作模型和视频生成器。作为策略，它在 RoboTwin 2.0 榜单名列前茅，在 LIBERO-plus 零样本成功率最高，在 CALVIN 和 LIBERO 上与专门的 VLA/世界-动作策略相当。迁移到真实人形机器人后，成功率高于由 π0.5 和 Cosmos 3 Edge 改造的策略，并可蒸馏成单步策略实现实时控制。
4）关键发现与意义：控制实验给出三条结论——按机器人特化能同时提升世界预测与控制；在适配早期就拆出动作专家更有帮助；策略适配时保留世界模型模式有助于应对场景变化。这说明“一个世界模型兼顾两种角色”是可行的，为跨机型通用机器人基础模型提供了可复制的训练范式。

rm.usage: 其“共享动作空间+世界-动作联合训练+拆分动作专家成策略”的配方可迁移到哨兵/多机策略的强化学习训练与sim-to-real，统一未来预测与策略生成，提升实车迁移鲁棒性。

items.title_en: EviScene: Beyond "Is It AI?" for Agentic Image Factuality Assessment
items.title_zh: EviScene：超越“是否为AI生成”的智能体式图像事实性评估
items.abstract_en: Determining whether an image is AI-generated does not establish whether the situation it depicts is factually supported. We formulate Image Factuality Assessment: given an image and a generic verification instruction, a system returns a supported or refuted verdict with an evidence-grounded explanation. Without a supplied textual claim, the system must progressively refine factual questions during investigation and align external evidence with the specific situation depicted. We introduce EviLens, an expert-reviewed benchmark of 10,174 supported and refuted images from controlled construction and web collection, covering twelve factual error types and evaluating both verdict accuracy and evidence sufficiency. We develop EviScene, a multimodal ReAct agent that interleaves visual inspection, external retrieval, and evidence analysis, using new findings to refine its questions and revisit relevant image details. We train a compact policy with supervised fine-tuning on reviewed teacher trajectories, followed by privileged on-policy self-distillation applied to verified decisions from the policy's own investigations. On the 1,527-image test set, the trained Qwen3.5-9B agent achieves 79.05% balanced accuracy and a Strict Evidence Sufficiency Rate (SESR) of 52.26%, improving over the same-backbone base agent by 6.71 and 9.37 percentage points, respectively. Its SESR is the highest among the evaluated agents.Code, models, and data will be released at https://github.com/wangzian828/EVISCENE and https://huggingface.co/ZiAnwang/EviScene.
items.abstract_zh: 判断一张图是否由AI生成，并不能说明它所描绘的情境是否有事实依据。我们提出“图像事实性评估”任务：给定一张图像和一条通用核查指令，系统需返回“支持”或“驳斥”的判定，并给出有证据支撑的解释。在没有给定文本主张的情况下，系统必须在调查过程中逐步细化事实问题，并将外部证据与图中具体情境对齐。我们提出 EviLens，一个经专家审阅的基准，包含来自受控构造与网络收集的10,174张支持与驳斥图像，覆盖12种事实错误类型，同时评估判定准确性与证据充分性。我们开发了 EviScene——一个多模态 ReAct 智能体，交替进行视觉检查、外部检索与证据分析，并利用新发现修正提问、重看相关图像细节。我们先用审阅过的教师轨迹做监督微调，再用特权在线自蒸馏，针对智能体自身调查中被验证的决策训练一个紧凑策略。在1,527张图像的测试集上，训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B 智能体达到79.05%的平衡准确率和52.26%的严格证据充分率（SESR），比同骨干基线智能体分别提升6.71和9.37个百分点，其 SESR 在所有被评估智能体中最高。代码、模型与数据将公开。
items.highlight_zh: 把图像核查从“是否AI生成”推进到“情境是否有事实依据”
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：判断一张图是不是AI生成的，并不能说明图中描绘的情境在现实中真有依据。作者提出“图像事实性评估”：给定一张图和一条通用核查指令，系统要给出“支持”或“驳斥”的结论，并附上有证据支撑的解释。难点在于没有现成文本主张，系统必须自己一步步细化问题，再把外部证据与图中具体情境对齐。
2）方法：构建 EviLens 基准，共10,174张来自受控构造与网络收集的支持/驳斥图像，覆盖12类事实错误，同时评估结论准确性与证据是否充分。提出 EviScene，一个多模态 ReAct 智能体，交替进行视觉检查、外部检索和证据分析，并用新发现反过来修正提问、回看图像细节。训练上，先用专家审阅过的教师轨迹做监督微调，再用特权在线自蒸馏，针对智能体自身调查中被验证的决策继续优化。
3）结果：在1,527张图的测试集上，训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B 智能体取得79.05%的平衡准确率和52.26%的严格证据充分率（SESR），比同骨干的基线智能体分别高出6.71和9.37个百分点，其 SESR 在被评估的智能体中最高。
4）意义：把“是不是AI图”升级为“图里的事有没有事实依据”，并给出可量化的证据充分性指标，为可信多模态核查提供了数据、方法与评测基准。

rm.usage: 图像事实性核查（支持/驳斥+证据）与自瞄、雷达、导航等赛事任务无关，基本用不上。

items.title_en: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
items.title_zh: LensErase：可擦除任意内容的基础模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 LensErase，一个基于掩码的通用“擦除任意内容”基础模型，覆盖广泛的真实擦除场景：各类物体、画面文字、水印及关联视觉效果、多目标擦除，以及各种目标尺度、长宽比和图像分辨率。为支撑如此广的覆盖面，我们构建了 LensErase-100M 大规模数据集，包含 1.0107 亿组覆盖多种擦除场景的“原图—掩码—目标图”配对样本。其次，我们以文生图模型 Lens 为底座预训练 LensErase，将其强生成先验迁移到基于掩码的擦除任务。为高效注入原图与擦除掩码，我们提出 Mask-Aware RoPE——一种 3D 旋转位置编码，把掩码信息直接注入原图 token，而无需额外的掩码 token 序列。最后，我们通过监督微调和带“契约引导、区域感知”奖励的强化学习精修模型，并在推理时用 TraceFusion 保持有效编辑区域外的高保真内容。在六个公开基准和提出的 LensErase-Bench 上，LensErase 在有参考的客观指标与无参考的 VLM 评测中均大幅提升。我们希望 LensErase 能成为擦除相关应用与系统的基础模型。
items.highlight_zh: 1亿组数据+文生图先验，一个模型擦除万物
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：图像擦除（去物体、去文字、去水印等）在真实场景中需求五花八门：目标大小、长宽比、分辨率、数量各不相同，还常需顺带抹掉阴影、倒影等关联视觉效果。单任务、小数据训练的模型很难覆盖这么多情况。
2) 方法：作者先把覆盖面做足——构建 LensErase-100M，含 1.0107 亿组“原图—掩码—目标图”配对样本，跨越多种擦除场景。模型以文生图模型 Lens 为底座预训练，把其强生成先验迁移到基于掩码的擦除任务。为高效注入原图与掩码信息，提出 Mask-Aware RoPE：一种 3D 旋转位置编码，把掩码信息直接写进原图 token，而不额外引入掩码 token 序列，从而省去冗余结构。随后用监督微调加强化学习精修，奖励设计为契约引导、区域感知；推理时用 TraceFusion 保证有效编辑区域之外的内容不被破坏、保持高保真。
3) 结果：在六个公开基准以及作者提出的 LensErase-Bench 上，无论是有参考图的客观指标，还是无参考的 VLM 评测，都取得显著提升。
4) 意义：把物体、文字、水印、多目标等各类擦除任务统一到一个基础模型中，具备跨对象、跨尺度、跨场景的通用性，可作为各类擦除应用与系统的底层模型。
items.comment: LensFamily Technical Report. Project page: https://lensfamily.github.io/LensErase/

rm.usage: 通用图像擦除/修复基础模型，可在离线环节用于数据增广，如擦除场景中多余目标或水印来扩充装甲板、能量单元训练集，但属外围工具，不直接解决比赛任务。

items.title_en: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
items.title_zh: 看见、保持与学习：多模态智能体记忆的演进
items.abstract_en: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态模型与智能体通过整合多种模态的信息，让 AI 系统能更像人一样从真实世界学习并与之交互。然而，随着多模态智能体走向长时程任务与终身学习，如何从复杂、异构的多模态数据中持续获取有用信息仍是重大挑战。应对这一挑战需要有效的记忆机制：能跨会话保持连续性、适应变化的用户与环境，并通过积累的经验改进记忆管理策略。我们提出一个面向多模态智能体记忆的双轴分析框架，围绕两个关键问题展开：多模态信息如何形成与表征（轴 I：形成与表征），以及其管理如何随经验积累而适应（轴 II：记忆管理）。轴 I 刻画哪些信息被保留、如何编码（如模态专属嵌入、文本与结构化记录、潜在与参数化表征），以支撑后续推理与行动。轴 II 区分三个层级：T1 静态记忆，复用固定记忆；T2 动态记忆，通过稳定策略更新记忆；T3 自演化记忆，通过不断演化的策略更新记忆。基于该框架，我们归纳出反复出现的设计模式，并提炼若干原则：平衡源信息保真与抽象、维护时间有效性与来源出处、让记忆使用根植于可恢复的证据，以及让记忆策略随时间演化。此外，我们讨论了多模态智能体记忆机制的挑战与潜在未来方向。
items.highlight_zh: 双轴框架+三级记忆，梳理多模态智能体记忆演进
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：多模态模型与智能体要像人一样，从文字、图像、音频等混杂信息中持续学习并与真实世界长期交互，最大瓶颈之一是记忆：如何跨会话保持连续性、适应不断变化的用户与环境，并凭借积累的经验改进自己的记忆管理策略，目前仍缺乏统一认识。
2) 方法：这是一篇综述/框架性文章。作者提出“双轴”分析框架来梳理整个领域。轴 I（形成与表征）回答“什么信息被保留、如何编码”，涵盖模态专属嵌入、文本与结构化记录，以及潜在与参数化表征等形式，目的是支撑后续推理与行动。轴 II（记忆管理）按经验积累程度分三层：T1 静态记忆，直接复用固定记忆；T2 动态记忆，用稳定策略更新记忆；T3 自演化记忆，用不断演化的策略更新记忆。
3) 结果：基于该框架，作者归纳出该领域反复出现的设计模式，并提炼若干原则：在源信息保真与抽象压缩之间取得平衡；维护记忆的时间有效性与来源出处；让记忆使用可追溯到可恢复的证据；以及让记忆策略随时间演化。
4) 意义：为多模态智能体记忆提供了统一的分类语言与设计准则，并指出在长时程、终身学习场景下仍待解决的挑战与未来方向，对后续研究具有路线图式的参考价值。

rm.usage: 多模态智能体记忆机制的分析框架，可作为哨兵长时程导航决策中「历史位置/敌情记忆」设计的思路参考，但偏综述理论，落地需自行设计，关联偏弱。

items.title_en: Cepheid: Decoupling Scale from Structure for Cross-Family Motion Completion
items.title_zh: Cepheid：面向跨几何族运动补全的尺度与结构解耦
items.abstract_en: Sparse-to-dense motion completion recovers dense mesh motion from sparse vertex displacements. Residual priors trained on one geometry family frequently fail to beat parameter-free harmonic extension off-family. Moreover, cross-family training meets a scaling barrier: residual amplitude varies by more than an order of magnitude across geometry families and collapses as observations become denser. Since this scale depends on unknown target motion, it cannot be measured directly at test time. We decouple residual structure from physical scale by learning a dimensionless prior, estimating amplitude from observables and a lightweight correction fitted only on training sources. Our unified model surpasses harmonic extension across all evaluated families, including unseen cloth and legged bodies, without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. The same prior applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body. Project page: https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/
items.abstract_zh: 稀疏到稠密的运动补全旨在从稀疏顶点位移恢复稠密网格运动。在某一几何族上训练的残差先验，一旦离开该族，往往打不过无需参数的调和延拓。此外，跨族训练还遇到尺度障碍：残差幅度在不同几何族间相差超过一个数量级，并且随观测变密而急剧缩小。由于该尺度取决于未知的目标运动，测试时无法直接测量。我们将残差结构与物理尺度解耦：学习一个无量纲先验来描述结构，从可观测量估计幅度，并加入一个仅在训练来源上拟合的轻量校正。我们的统一模型在所有评估过的几何族上都优于调和延拓，包括未见过的布料与足式身体，且无需骨架、配准或跨网格对应关系。同一先验无需重新训练即可用于点跟踪的动物视频，以及机器人抓取软体物体的场景。
items.highlight_zh: 解耦残差结构与物理尺度，实现跨几何族运动补全
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：如何从少量稀疏顶点位移，恢复出稠密的网格运动（稀疏到稠密运动补全）。作者指出两个痛点：在一个几何族上训练的残差先验，换到别的几何族时常常还不如完全无需参数的调和延拓；而跨族训练又撞上“尺度障碍”——不同几何族的残差幅度相差一个数量级以上，并且观测越密幅度越小。麻烦的是，这个尺度取决于未知的目标运动，测试时根本无法直接量出来。
2）方法：Cepheid 把残差的“结构”和“物理尺度”拆开处理：先学一个无量纲的先验，只描述残差的形状结构；尺度则从测试时可观测的量中估计，再加一个只在训练来源上拟合的轻量校正来补偿偏差。
3）结果：这个统一模型在评估过的所有几何族上都胜过调和延拓，包括训练中没见过的布料和足式身体，而且不需要骨架、配准或跨网格对应关系。同一个先验不用重新训练，就能直接用在点跟踪得到的动物视频上，也适用于机器人抓取软体物体的场景。
4）意义：它点出了一个被忽视却很根本的问题——残差幅度随几何族与观测密度剧烈变化，并给出可信的解耦方案，使运动补全模型真正具备跨族、跨域泛化能力。

rm.usage: 跨几何族的网格运动补全与软体抓取场景与比赛（装甲板识别、旋转能量机关、刚性能量单元装配）关联弱，基本用不上。

items.title_en: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
items.title_zh: 面向导航的数据中心式递归自我改进：通过策略同步的语言-动作双自举
items.abstract_en: Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言导航要求智能体按自然语言指令抵达目标位置，高质量语言监督因此至关重要。人工标注昂贵，已有可扩展合成方法要么用分离模型分别做导航与指令生成，要么用任务专用组件耦合两者；多数方法还用固定模型一次性标注整个轨迹语料再进行更新，使生成的监督滞后于策略演化。为此，我们提出 RSI-Nav——面向导航的数据中心式递归自我改进框架，通过策略同步的语言-动作双自举，在共享模型中统一「视觉-语言到动作」的指令跟随与「视觉-动作到语言」的指令生成。监督微调奠定基础能力后，RSI-Nav 以小块分片处理无标注轨迹：当前模型生成指令、执行以评估目标完成与路径效率、保留合格样本，并在处理下一片前立即自我更新，使新监督与策略同步。我们同时引入空间理解数据。实验表明，RSI-Nav 在 R2R-CE 上达到 68.6% 成功率，RxR-CE 上 72.4%，并带来更强的指令生成效用与适度提升的空间理解。
items.highlight_zh: 让语言监督与策略同步演化，R2R-CE 成功率 68.6%
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体听懂自然语言指令并走到目标地点，所以「语言监督」的质量非常关键。人工标注太贵，已有自动合成方法有两大毛病：一是导航和指令生成用两个分开的模型，或者靠任务专用模块勉强耦合；二是先把整个轨迹库用一个固定模型标注完，再去更新策略，于是标注出来的监督总是「落后」于正在进化的策略。
2. 用了什么方法：作者提出 RSI-Nav，核心是「策略同步的语言-动作双自举」。它在同一个共享模型里同时做两件事：视觉+语言→动作（按指令走）和视觉+动作→语言（给轨迹写指令）。训练分两步：先用监督微调打好底子，然后把海量无标注轨迹切成小片（shard）逐片处理——当前模型先给这批轨迹生成指令，再执行这些指令，检查是否真的到达目标、路径是否高效，合格的样本留下用来自我更新，更新完才处理下一片。这样「新造出来的监督」和「刚刚更新过的策略」始终对得上。作者还额外加入空间理解数据，因为空间推理更强对导航有帮助。
3. 有什么结果：在 R2R-CE 基准上成功率达到 68.6%，RxR-CE 上达到 72.4%；经过这种递归演化后，模型写指令的能力也更强，空间理解有小幅提升。
4. 为何重要：它说明「边造数据边更新模型、让二者同步」比「一次性离线标注」更有效，也说明把指令生成与指令执行放进同一个模型可以互相促进，为可扩展的导航数据自举提供了一条实用路径。

rm.usage: “策略同步的语言-动作双自举、分片在线自我更新”的递归自我改进范式可迁移到哨兵导航/策略训练：自生成指令+执行验证筛选数据并即时更新策略，降低实车标注与调试成本。

items.title_en: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
items.title_zh: WAVE-0：以轻量隐未来预测桥接 VLA 策略与世界动作模型
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies excel at generalist robotic manipulation but generate actions without explicitly modeling their environmental consequences. World action models (WAMs) incorporate future prediction, yet most rely on costly video generation, while latent alternatives either use predicted futures only as auxiliary targets or infer latent actions from suboptimal visual transitions through costly large-scale video pretraining. We introduce WAVE-0 (World-model-Augmented VLA Execution), a framework that bridges VLAs and WAMs through a lightweight latent world model. By connecting the semantic understanding of pretrained VLAs with explicit future prediction, WAVE-0 allows anticipated action consequences to directly guide action generation. Built on a pretrained VLA, its 257M world model translates VLM-generated latent action plans into predicted future representations that condition the action expert, unifying latent planning, future prediction, and action generation. The world model is trained directly on ground-truth robot actions with a counterfactual ranking objective, requiring neither pixel reconstruction nor large-scale video pretraining. WAVE-0 achieves success rates of 91.47% on RoboTwin 2.0 and 98.7% on LIBERO, along with 88.0%, 61.4%, and 75.0% on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para, respectively. On real-world tasks, it improves the success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 38.3% to 73.3%. These results demonstrate strong manipulation performance and generalization across diverse distribution shifts.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略擅长通用机器人操作，但生成动作时并不显式建模其环境后果。世界动作模型（WAM）引入未来预测，但多数依赖昂贵的视频生成；基于隐空间的替代方案要么仅把预测未来当作辅助目标，要么需通过昂贵的大规模视频预训练，从次优的视觉转移中推断隐动作。我们提出 WAVE-0（世界模型增强的 VLA 执行），用一个轻量隐世界模型桥接 VLA 与 WAM。它把预训练 VLA 的语义理解与显式的未来预测相连，使预想的动作后果直接指导动作生成。其 2.57 亿参数的世界模型将 VLM 生成的隐动作计划转化为预测的未来表征，用以条件化动作专家，统一了隐规划、未来预测与动作生成。该世界模型直接以真值机器人动作、用反事实排序目标训练，无需像素重建或大规模视频预训练。WAVE-0 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上成功率 91.47%，LIBERO 上 98.7%，LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Para 上分别为 88.0%、61.4%、75.0%；在真实任务中把 π0.5 的成功率从 38.3% 提升到 73.3%，展现出强操作性能与跨分布偏移的泛化能力。
items.highlight_zh: 轻量隐世界模型让 VLA 预判动作后果，真机成功率近翻倍
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略是当下通用的机器人操作模型，但它只负责「看到、听懂、出动作」，并不显式思考「这个动作会让环境变成什么样」。世界动作模型（WAM）能预测未来，可大多靠生成视频来实现，代价昂贵；一些用隐空间代替视频的做法，要么只把预测的未来当作训练时的辅助任务，并不真正用它来指导出动作，要么必须靠大规模视频预训练，从质量并不理想的视觉变化里反推隐动作，成本同样很高。
2. 用了什么方法：作者提出 WAVE-0（World-model-Augmented VLA Execution）。做法是在一个预训练 VLA 之上外挂一个仅 2.57 亿参数的轻量隐世界模型：VLM 先给出隐动作计划，这个世界模型把计划翻译成「未来会变成什么样」的表征，再用这个未来表征去条件化动作专家（action expert），也就是让「预想的后果」直接参与动作生成。由此，隐规划、未来预测、动作生成被统一在一个框架里。训练上，世界模型直接拿真值机器人动作做监督，用反事实排序（counterfactual ranking）目标学习，既不需要重建像素，也不需要跑大规模视频预训练，训练成本大幅下降。
3. 有什么结果：在仿真基准 RoboTwin 2.0 上成功率 91.47%，LIBERO 上 98.7%；在更难的分布偏移版本 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Para 上分别为 88.0%、61.4%、75.0%。真实世界任务中，把 π0.5 的成功率从 38.3% 提升到 73.3%，几乎翻倍。
4. 为何重要：它证明了「让机器人先在心里预演一下后果」并不一定要付出视频生成或大规模视频预训练的代价——一个轻量隐空间世界模型就够了，而且能同时提升操作能力和对分布变化的泛化性，为 VLA 与世界模型的结合提供了一条低成本、可扩展的路线。

rm.usage: 用轻量隐世界模型增强VLA动作生成的思路可参考到工程视觉装配的机械臂策略，以及哨兵自主交火/走位的RL训练，通过预测动作后果提升跨分布鲁棒性。

items.title_en: Open-o3-Video-v2: Seek, Ground, and Reason with Verifiable Spatio-Temporal Evidence
items.title_zh: Open-o3-Video-v2：基于可验证时空证据的寻找、定位与推理
items.abstract_en: Reliable video reasoning requires models to produce correct answers and expose supporting visual evidence. Open-o3-Video enables verifiable reasoning by embedding timestamps and object-level bounding boxes into reasoning traces, but is restricted to frames from an initial sparse sampler. We introduce Open-o3-Video-v2, which formulates video reasoning as a unified agentic evidencegrounded process. The model identifies missing information, acquires additional observations, grounds the moments and objects supporting its reasoning, and writes this evidence into the trajectory before continuing or answering. To support this behavior, we construct STGR-v2-CoT135K, including 52K multi-turn agentic grounded reasoning trajectories, and STGR-v2-RL-13K for reinforcement learning. We further propose Clue-Seek GRPO (CS-GRPO), which tracks how tool calls change accumulated evidence, rewards clue coverage and step-wise gains, and penalizes excessive, repetitive, or uninformative retrieval. On V-STaR, Open-o3-Video-v2-4B achieves 40.4% mAM and 56.3% mLGM, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-4B backbone by 8.5% and 12.6%, respectively. It also delivers consistent gains across general video understanding, long-video reasoning, and temporal grounding benchmarks. These results show that active evidence acquisition and verifiable object-level grounding are complementary for reliable video reasoning. The code and models are released at https://msalab-pku.github.io/projects/Open-o3-Video-v2.
items.comment: Extension of Open-o3-Video (https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20579). V2 extends single-pass grounded reasoning to agentic multi-turn evidence seeking and grounding, enabling models to actively acquire and reason over missing visual evidence. We further introduce STGR-v2-CoT-135K and CS-GRPO to improve evidence acquisition and grounded reasoning

items.title_en: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
items.title_zh: APT：面向文本到图像生成的反馈驱动智能体式后期训练
items.abstract_en: Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.
items.abstract_zh: 后训练对提升文本到图像模型至关重要，但现有流程通常依赖人工挑选的训练数据和固定的训练分布。我们提出 APT（智能体式后训练），一个全自动框架，能根据模型不断变化的能力画像自适应地后训练基座模型。APT 协调三个智能体：从用户需求构建评测集、诊断模型特有的优势与失败模式、并生成带自适应提示分布的强化学习数据，重点强化表现欠佳的能力。通过反复评测、诊断与更新生成器，APT 让当前模型的行为塑造其下一轮训练任务，形成受“递归自我改进”启发的反馈闭环。针对没有用户指定评测场景的通用设置，我们进一步开发了一套评测工具，可生成广泛而多样的评测集。在多个基座模型、基准与生成架构上的实验表明，APT 与模型无关、与基准无关、与架构无关，且完全自动化。
items.highlight_zh: 让模型自诊断弱点并生成训练数据，全自动后训练
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：后训练（post-training）是提升文本到图像模型画质与指令遵循能力的关键，但现有流程往往依赖人工挑选训练数据、训练分布固定不变——不管模型当前弱在哪里，训练内容都大同小异，效率低、针对性差。
2) 方法：作者提出 APT（Agentic Post-Training，智能体式后训练），一个全自动框架，让后训练随模型能力画像自适应推进。它由三个智能体协作：第一个依据用户需求构建评测集；第二个诊断模型自身的强项与失败模式；第三个据此生成强化学习数据，并自适应调整提示词分布，把重点放在表现欠佳的能力上。整个流程反复执行“评测—诊断—更新生成器”，让当前模型的行为塑造其下一轮训练任务，形成类似“递归自我改进”的反馈闭环。针对没有用户指定评测场景的通用情形，作者还开发了一套评测 harness，可自动生成广泛多样的评测集。
3) 结果：在多个基座模型、多个基准和多种生成架构上的实验表明，APT 与模型无关、与基准无关、与架构无关，且完全自动化。
4) 意义：把后训练从“人工定数据、固定分布”推进到“模型自己决定下一课学什么”，为能够持续自我提升的生成模型提供了一条可扩展的自动化路径。

items.title_en: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
items.title_zh: WorldRecon：面向大规模3D世界的生成式多视图网格重建
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.

items.title_en: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 更多方法，更好的智能体？对智能体强化学习中自蒸馏的现实检验
items.abstract_en: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
items.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习中的自蒸馏方法日益增多，但现有评估常在不同实验条件下复用已发表的基线分数，缺乏同期方法之间的直接比较，也较少关注训练稳定性与计算成本，导致性能提升来源不明。为此，我们在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA 和 WebShop 上，对三种模型规模比较了十种代表性方法与 GRPO，共完成 132 次训练运行，累计记录 12,124.4 个 H800 GPU 小时，并在 8 个 rollout 随机种子上对预训练骨干与全部 11 种方法重复评估。除最终表现外，还考察训练进程、稳定性与实测成本。结果发现：相对 GRPO 的增益范围有限，没有方法能稳定胜出；强最终性能可能掩盖训练不稳定；更高训练成本未必带来更好表现。
items.highlight_zh: 十种自蒸馏方法对比 GRPO：增益有限、训练不稳、算力未必换性能
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：自蒸馏（self-distillation）近年来被大量用于智能体强化学习，声称能让智能体更聪明，但社区缺少统一、公平的比较——很多论文直接引用别人的基线分数，实验条件却各不相同，也几乎不谈训练稳定性与算力开销，于是“提升到底来自哪里”变得模糊。

方法：作者搭建统一基准，把 10 种代表性自蒸馏方法与标准 GRPO 放在同一套条件下比较，覆盖 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA、WebShop 四个智能体任务和三种模型规模，共完成 132 次训练，累计 12,124.4 个 H800 GPU 小时；对预训练骨干和全部 11 种方法在 8 个 rollout 随机种子上反复评测，同时记录训练曲线、稳定性与实测成本。

结果：三点关键发现——①相对 GRPO 的增益范围有限，没有任何方法能在所有设置下稳定占优；②最终分数高不等于训练稳定，部分方法波动剧烈，好成绩可能来自幸运的随机种子；③多花的算力并不总能换来更好表现，投入与收益不成正比。

为何重要：这项工作戳破了“方法越多、智能体越强”的乐观假设，指出当前自蒸馏方法大多只是在特定条件下小幅领先。它提供了可复现的公开基准与成本数据，提醒研究者在报告结果时给出稳定性与开销证据，并把后续方向引向真正可靠、性价比高的智能体训练。

rm.usage: 对智能体强化学习自蒸馏方法的严格复现与比较结论，可指导哨兵/策略 RL 训练时如何选方法、评估稳定性与控制算力，属支撑性参考而非直接可用方案。

items.title_en: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
items.title_zh: ACCRUE：面向机器人基础模型的持续离策略强化学习
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.

rm.usage: 持续离策略强化学习框架可保留跨任务学到的行为，适合在仿真/实车中分阶段训练哨兵自瞄交火、走位策略而不遗忘旧技能，用于团队策略的持续迭代。

items.title_en: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: GroundGUI：基于高质量数据与「蒸馏到强化学习」的 GUI 定位
items.abstract_en: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.
items.abstract_zh: 构建稳健的 GUI 智能体依赖多模态视觉定位：把自然语言意图精确映射为屏幕上可操作的组件。尽管各类 GUI 基准已很丰富，面向多样环境的高保真资源仍相当稀缺。为此我们提出 ScreenRef——一个覆盖桌面、网页与移动端的 GUI 定位数据集，含 58.6 万张截图和逾 63.3 万条指代表达实例，涉及文字识别、视觉匹配、空间理解与拒答等任务。我们进一步提出 Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning（D2RL），以缓解监督微调泛化不足与强化学习奖励稀疏的问题。基于 ScreenRef 顺序进行 SFT 与 D2RL 训练 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，得到 GroundGUI-8B，在 ScreenSpot-V2 达 95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro 63.9%、OSWorld-G 65.4%、MMBench-GUI L2 86.8%、UI-Vision 38.3%，在 8B 规模中显著优于基于开源数据训练的模型，与闭源数据训练的模型相当甚至更优。
items.highlight_zh: 开源数据加蒸馏到强化学习，8B 模型 GUI 定位媲美闭源数据模型
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：GUI 智能体要能“看懂”屏幕并按指令点击，关键是把“点这个提交按钮”这类自然语言准确对应到屏幕上的具体位置（GUI grounding）。训练这种能力需要大量高质量标注数据，尤其是跨桌面、网页、移动端的资源，但公开的高保真数据却很少。

方法：作者先构建 ScreenRef 数据集——58.6 万张界面截图，配 63.3 万多条指代表达，用框或点标注目标，覆盖文字识别、视觉匹配、空间理解以及“拒绝回答”（屏幕上没有对应目标时）等场景。训练策略上提出 D2RL：先做监督微调（SFT）让模型掌握基本定位，再用强化学习继续提升；但强化学习奖励过于稀疏，于是先用蒸馏方式预热策略来缓解这一难题。

结果：以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为基础，顺序进行 SFT 和 D2RL，得到 GroundGUI-8B。它在 ScreenSpot-V2 上达 95.2%，ScreenSpot-Pro 63.9%，OSWorld-G 65.4%，MMBench-GUI L2 86.8%，UI-Vision 38.3%。在 8B 规模中，它明显超过用开源数据训练的模型，甚至与用闭源数据训练的模型相当或更好，而代码、模型与数据全部开源。

为何重要：它说明“高质量数据＋蒸馏到强化学习”的组合，能让中小规模开源模型在 GUI 定位上逼近闭源方案，降低了构建实用 GUI 智能体的门槛，也为后续研究提供了可复现的数据与训练范式。

rm.usage: GUI 元素定位与「蒸馏到强化学习」训练范式，与装甲板/能量机关的视觉定位问题形式不同（屏幕坐标 vs 三维位姿），仅 D2RL 训练流程有参考意义，关联较弱。

items.title_en: Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon
items.title_zh: 长时域强化学习需要Muon
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents must coordinate reasoning, tool use, and environment feedback over extended interactions. Learning from sparse outcome rewards requires weighting trajectories of different lengths and updating the policy while rollouts are still being collected. We examine a single-rollout asynchronous recipe combining Muon, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary length and tool-error penalties. Single-rollout sampling allows asynchronous learning without waiting for multiple trajectories for the same issue. We study optimizer choices and recipe components for repository-level issue resolution across two model families. The evaluated training runs show higher training success with the full recipe than with the baselines.

rm.usage: 长时程 RL 的优化器（Muon）、token 平均损失与截断重要性采样等配方，可用于哨兵/雷达自主交火与走位的强化学习训练，改善稀疏奖励下的稳定性，需迁移到实车场景。

items.title_en: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
items.title_zh: OmniPoser：基于Masked Flow Matching的野外灵活人体运动恢复
items.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.
items.comment: Accepted as a poster at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026

items.title_en: Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics
items.title_zh: 物理时间作为机器人策略记忆动力学中缺失的维度
items.abstract_en: Existing robot policy memories typically evolve with observation sequences, implicitly treating each update as the same amount of physical time. Yet identical observation histories can span different durations and require different actions, exposing physical time as a missing dimension of policy memory. We introduce Temporal Flow Policy (TFP), which learns memory dynamics to retain past events and evolve the memory state over measured time intervals. Observations and prior memory determine the content and time scales of each transition; elapsed time determines how far the state advances. TFP conditions diffusion and flow-matching policies through this memory state and is trained with their native imitation objectives. We evaluate TFP with Diffusion Policy and $π_{0.5}$ through controlled comparisons of memory designs. These experiments show that successful timing depends on both measured intervals and retained history. TFP achieves higher average success than the recurrent and state-space memories we equip with the same intervals and than a variant that feeds the interval to a learned gate. Memory readouts recover the time since an event and motion information after occlusion. Changing the supplied intervals systematically delays or advances actions, linking time inputs to behavior. Real-robot tasks requiring timing or memory, together with LIBERO evaluations, demonstrate benefits in physical and general manipulation. These results suggest viewing robot memory not as stored observation history, but as a state that retains past events and evolves with physical time.

rm.usage: 其『物理时间作为记忆维度』思想可用于哨兵/自瞄的时序决策网络：让策略记忆按真实经过时间（而非固定帧数）演化，适配不同帧率、通信延迟与运动预测场景，改善小陀螺下的动作时机判断。

items.title_en: Tiered-Resolution Volumetric Mapping for Real-Time Simultaneous Planning and Mapping on Natural Outdoor Environments
items.title_zh: 面向自然户外环境实时同步规划与建图的分层分辨率体素建图
items.abstract_en: Real-time volumetric mapping for a planning robot is dominated by the cost of integrating and storing information at the finest resolution, yet only a small fraction of any map ever lies on or near a path the planner actually considers. We exploit this with a tiered-resolution mapping mechanism that integrates LiDAR into a single map structure at two resolutions simultaneously: fine inside a corridor around the robot's current plan, and coarse everywhere else. As opposed to traditional navigation pipelines where path planning uses the mapping result and provides no feedback, we propose a feedback loop where planning also informs mapping to dynamically integrate information at different leaf resolutions. Across two real-world teleoperated datasets, replayed and scored offline against an independent full-resolution map, the tiered maps are 13-15x smaller and require 6-8x less integration CPU time than a uniform fine map, while producing paths at a similar cost per meter as the ones generated from fine resolution maps on both scenarios. A uniform coarse map reaches the same size savings but its path quality collapses (+210% cost per meter) on the harder scenario, because it over-discretizes terrain the robot must traverse. Tiering approximates the coarse map's cheapness without its failure mode.
items.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, IROS 2026 "Data in Field Robotics: From State Estimation to Navigation" workshop

rm.usage: 分层分辨率体素建图+规划反馈直接契合哨兵自主导航：在规划路径走廊内用高分辨率、其余区域用粗分辨率，兼顾实时性与精度，可用于跨越高地/隧道等复杂地形时的建图与路径规划。

items.title_en: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
items.title_zh: QK-Edit：重新审视MM-DiT中基于注意力的注入用于图像和视频编辑
items.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.

items.title_en: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING
items.title_zh: 基于DAO和JING的生成式世界模拟
items.abstract_en: We present a Generative World Simulation framework that couples persistent shared world state with continuous first-person audiovisual generation. The framework integrates DAO, a computable world engine, and JING, an Egocentric Interactive Experience Model, to support sustained interaction for humans and agents. DAO maintains the states of characters, objects, and spaces and their relationships, advancing the world according to interaction rules and world time while preserving the consequences of past actions. From this evolving state, DAO derives observer-specific conditions for JING, which combines these conditions with character, object, and scene references, observation history, and current actions to generate each observer's audiovisual experience. Users can explore environments, manipulate objects, and communicate with characters through viewpoint control and text instructions, with their actions shaping both the shared state and subsequent experiences. By connecting world-state evolution with experience generation in a continuous interaction loop, the framework offers an approach to building interactive worlds that retain their history, evolve through action, and persist beyond any individual observer.

items.title_en: PACT: Posture-Aligned Co-Design Technique for Hand Configuration and Retargeting in Multi-Finger Imitation Learning
items.title_zh: PACT：用于多指模仿学习中手部构型与重定向的姿态对齐协同设计技术
items.abstract_en: The fidelity of teleoperated demonstrations used for imitation learning is determined by how faithfully a robot hand can replicate the operator's posture. The posture retargeting law that the robot will execute is typically selected only once the hardware has been finalized, and conventional hand designs often neglect human-like grasping postures. We introduce PACT, an optimization based on human grasping postures that jointly optimizes the mechanical parameters of a 17-servo robot hand (link lengths, joint offsets, mounting angles, and base placements) and its nonlinear posture retargeter (a linear human-to-robot joint map, per-joint posture-IK weights, and damping). The optimization enforces full-finger correspondence (MCP, PIP, DIP, and tip of each finger) to human poses from the DexYCB dataset, and is constrained by servo interference, assembly clearances, and flat-hand protrusion, so the resulting design can be physically assembled. We fabricate the PACT Hand and validate it through teleoperation experiments and an imitation-learning demonstration. The hand reproduces all human hand keypoints with a kinematic RMSE of 3.9 mm, compared to 12.8 mm for the LEAP Hand baseline, and keeps all fingertips within 10 mm on every grasping posture, while the baseline achieves this for only 21.6% of the poses. Under matched per-joint torque limits, it lifts twice the baseline payload, 2 kg against 1 kg, and deforms a held paper cup seven times less, reaching a deformation level comparable to a human hand. It also achieves an 86% grasping success rate on YCB daily objects, compared to 64% for the baseline. Finally, as a demonstration, an imitation-learning policy trained on demonstrations collected with the PACT Hand achieved a 75% success rate at held-out placements in a can pick-and-place task. Project page: https://pact-hand-2027.github.io
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://pact-hand-2027.github.io

items.title_en: Intent-guided Adaptive Stiffening for Visuomotor Policies under Unknown Resistance
items.title_zh: 面向未知阻力下视觉运动策略的意图引导自适应刚度增强
items.abstract_en: Manipulation tasks such as unscrewing a cap or sliding a part in contact with a surface require imposing force along a high-friction direction: the robot must overcome a resistance rather than yield to it. Generative visuomotor policies predict the motion for such tasks but not the authority needed to realize it, and that authority is bounded by the impedance controller beneath them: when the resistance exceeds what a compliant controller can exert under a bounded tracking error, the task is unattainable however accurate the prediction is. The required amount cannot be anticipated either, since it depends on a contact state the observation does not reveal. In this paper, we propose a residual stiffening layer placed underneath an unmodified policy. Resistance is recognized, without force sensing, from the mismatch between the motion the policy commands and the motion the robot realizes, and a four-mode supervisor raises the stiffness along a single direction read off the policy's own action chunk, retains it while the task progresses and releases it afterwards. The layer needs no compliance labels, no retraining and no re-collected demonstrations. On two real tasks, unscrewing a bottle cap and pushing a T-nut along a T-slot groove against non-homogeneous friction, evaluated at six resistance levels of which two were withheld from the demonstrations, the layer raises the success rate from 52% to 90% while producing 61% less peak off-axis force than a uniformly stiff controller at the same resistance.

items.title_en: Collective Learning for Unified Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Dynamics Adaptation
items.title_zh: 通过预测动力学自适应实现统一机器人操作的集体学习
items.abstract_en: Learning a collective policy for state-based Cartesian manipulation across diverse robotic embodiments presents a fundamental challenge due to embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. Collective learning aggregates multi-robot experience to discover shared task structure, yet naive aggregation can average incompatible action modes when different embodiments realize the same Cartesian command through different transition behavior. This leads to strategy ambiguity and performance collapse on dynamically outlying embodiments. To address this, we propose PACE, a two-stage collective learning framework that separates shared task-space intent from embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. The first stage employs a representation layer pre-trained on offline trajectories to extract task-level context from collective data. The second stage introduces a decision layer equipped with a predictive dynamics adapter. By forcing the latent state to predict future transitions, this adapter acts as a latent regularizer that grounds the policy in the transition behavior of the executing robot while preserving real-time inference without online planning. Evaluations across simulated embodiments demonstrate that our method prevents performance collapse on distinct robots. It achieves over 93\% overall success and 89\% on dynamically out-of-distribution zero-shot simulated robots, outperforming the Transformer behavior cloning (82\%) and diffusion policy baselines (66\%). Physical KUKA deployment further validates the feasibility of the full state-based pipeline under zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
items.comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

items.title_en: Benchmarking 3D Reconstruction for Under-Ice Robotic Perception in Arctic Environments
items.title_zh: 面向北极环境冰下机器人感知的3D重建基准测试
items.abstract_en: As the Arctic transitions toward a seasonally ice-free state, capturing the complex morphology of submerged sea ice is crucial for advancing models of ocean-ice-atmosphere heat exchange and monitoring under-ice habitats. Currently, sub-surface ice mapping is predominantly achieved through acoustic sensors such as multibeam sonar. While sonar provides robust large-scale geometry, it lacks spectral and high-resolution textural information required to record fine morphological features - a critical limitation in under-ice environments, where sparse visual features and degraded sensing conditions challenge the capture of detailed structural and optical surface properties. We present a benchmark for vision-based under-ice 3D reconstruction using real-world data from the MOSAiC expedition and synthetic data generated in an Unreal Engine-based underwater robotics simulator. The benchmark evaluates Structure-From-Motion (SfM) and monocular depth estimation, with quantitative comparison enabled through cross-modal registration to upward-looking multibeam sonar.

items.title_en: Mobility-Budget-Constrained Submodular Maximization for Distributed Semantic Multi-Robot Exploration
items.title_zh: 面向分布式语义多机器人探索的移动预算约束次模最大化
items.abstract_en: Multi-robot exploration under communication and mobility constraints requires balancing information gain with reachability. We present a distributed semantic exploration framework that combines Dirichlet mapping, budget-constrained trajectory selection, and Resource-Aware distributed Greedy (RAG) coordination. Each robot clusters frontiers, computes terrain- and heading-aware least-cost paths with a single budget-limited Dijkstra search, and selects feasible paths by marginal information gain, represented by the expected reduction in Dirichlet entropy. Each robot's per-round selection is exact, the team's joint per-round information gain is at least half the centralized optimum, and the bound degrades gracefully under limited communication. Ten-run gridworld ablations show improved coverage, semantic mIoU, and map certainty with lower entropy and traversal cost per unit distance than shortest-distance frontier selection. Budget-sensitivity experiments show that an intermediate budget best balances path reach and receding-horizon execution. In photorealistic full-system simulation against five coordination rules run in their native published forms, the proposed method attains the highest mean coverage and semantic accuracy while being the only one that respects the per-trajectory mobility budget.
items.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the IROS 2026 SeMaNa Workshop. The first two authors contributed equally

items.title_en: Improving Policy Learning from Delayed Interventions
items.title_zh: 改进基于延迟干预的策略学习
items.abstract_en: In this work, we explore the idea of expert intervention delays in human-supervised robotic systems for imitation learning system. Previous works in imitation learning have primarily examined the impact of suboptimal experts, where the expert policy makes mistakes, but assumed expert interventions occur immediately after errors are made. Although delayed expert intervention can be viewed as a form of noise that might improve policy robustness, our results show that learning from delayed expert interventions is overall less effective than learning from non-delayed expert interventions; delayed expert interventions are less effective at demonstrating error avoidance behaviors. To address this, we propose Learning from Delayed Intervention (LfDI), which learns a cost function based on where and when the expert intervenes, combined with limited information about the extent of intervention delays provided by the expert. This cost function is then used to infer additional supervision for states without expert data, guiding the policy to avoid states that would likely trigger interventions. We evaluate our method, Learning from Delayed Intervention (LfDI), on simulated environments and show that it outperforms other methods that do not account for intervention delays.

items.title_en: Acting Through Registers
items.title_zh: 通过寄存器行动
items.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) use generative visual representations to condition robot actions, yet how these representations organize action-relevant information remains poorly understood. We identify persistent high-norm spatial outliers in WAM representations and find that their action relevance persists even after normalization and K/V projection attenuate their extreme magnitude. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RegisterWAM, which adds learnable non-spatial registers to the world model and uses them directly for action conditioning. Registers alone do not fully eliminate spatial outliers; pairing them with observation flow-matching (FM) loss supervision suppresses spatial outliers while concentrating high-norm responses in registers. Beyond this reorganization, observation FM loss supervision also improves action learning without registers, motivating an additional noised-observation FM objective that learns current-scene recovery from corrupted inputs. The resulting model achieves 81.64\% success on LIBERO-Plus without additional embodied pretraining data or foundation models, reaches 93.0\% average success on RoboTwin 2.0, and improves real-world manipulation performance.

items.title_en: Lifted State Policy Optimization: Internalizing Self-Correction through Transition Geometry
items.title_zh: 提升状态策略优化：通过转移几何内化自我纠正
items.abstract_en: Preference optimization ranks final answers and trajectory RL maximizes aggregate returns, yet neither credits the local change that turns a flawed reasoning state into a better one. We introduce Lifted State Policy Optimization (LSPO), which establishes this finite, cost-adjusted transition as the primary unit of learning. Each textual answer is augmented with a learned continuous coordinate, forming a lifted state that an energy function evaluates and orders. A shaped reward drives energy descent net of edit and step costs, and an internalization loss absorbs selected low-energy answers into the direct generator. On Qwen3.5-27B, the resulting single-pass policy reaches 71.8% aggregate accuracy across mathematics, science, code, and logic benchmarks, matching test-time reflection at 71.9% with 28% lower latency and 25.8% fewer tokens. The pattern holds across dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, and matched controls confirm that transition credit and the lifted coordinate each contribute, as does answer internalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/Venomrko/lspo.
items.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Originally titled "Self-Correction as Transition Geometry: Internalizing Reasoning via Lifted State Policy Optimization."

items.title_en: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
items.title_zh: 面向机器人策略的高效测试时自适应
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.

items.title_en: Predicting Unseen Scientific Interactions: Conditional Flow Models Hallucinate Non-Additive Effects
items.title_zh: 预测未见过的科学相互作用：条件流模型幻觉出非加性效应
items.abstract_en: Conditional generative models are increasingly used for scientific prediction beyond the direct training support. Yet scientific questions often concern whether one intervention changes the effect of another. Such interactions can be of primary interest while explaining little of the total variation, allowing models to appear accurate overall without recovering the relevant scientific effect. It remains unclear how these models learn interactions and when these successfully extrapolate to unseen conditions. We therefore study interaction recovery in flow-matching models using a physiological time-series simulator, drug dose-response data, combinatorial cell perturbations, and molecular conformer generations, where we separate recovery from hallucinated interaction structure. In the controlled setting, individual effects are learned much earlier than interactions and models hallucinate interactions where none exist. Across settings, we find qualitatively different generalization problems, with successful prediction depending on whether condition structure continues from observed to held-out targets. When it does, interactions are recoverable. If not, models can generate plausible responses while missing the interaction. We furthermore find that hallucinations increase as targets become less identifiable, and that successful interaction recovery in output space can fail under nonlinear readouts. Finally, we show that aggregate fidelity metrics can conceal whether models learn and extrapolate interactions.
items.comment: Accepted as an oral at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR). Code: https://github.com/SamGijsen/interaction-flows

items.title_en: TANGO: RNA Topology and Geometry Co-Design
items.title_zh: TANGO：RNA 拓扑与几何协同设计
items.abstract_en: Designing RNA sequences that satisfy target tertiary-structure objectives is an important problem in RNA engineering, with broad applications in synthetic biology and therapeutics. Existing 3D RNA design methods have made substantial progress, but they largely treat the target fold as a geometry-only objective. This is incomplete for RNA, whose functional folds are specified not only by tertiary geometry but also by secondary base-pairing topology. We therefore formulate RNA inverse design as a topology-and-geometry co-design problem and propose TANGO, a multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for this task. TANGO adopts a staged curriculum: it first learns a topology-aware policy from secondary-structure targets, then transfers this policy to tertiary-structure targets to train a general co-design model, and finally applies frontier-guided fine-tuning to refine target-specific trade-offs among secondary-structure fidelity, tertiary-structure fidelity, and sequence diversity. Experiments show that TANGO generates diverse and novel designs, improving tertiary- and secondary-structure performance by 18.3% and 52.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

items.title_en: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: MolHop：基于智能体强化学习的骨架跃迁分子设计
items.abstract_en: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.

items.title_en: LiFi: LiDAR Generation from Multi-View Images via Geometric and Semantic Collaborative Guidance
items.title_zh: LiFi：通过几何与语义协同引导从多视图图像生成 LiDAR
items.abstract_en: Generating LiDAR point clouds from multi-view camera images is a valuable task with applications in controllable data synthesis, cross-modal simulation and various perception tasks. However, most existing methods are not specifically designed for this task, and the quality of their generated LiDAR remains limited. Moreover, these methods typically focus only on semantic cues in images or generate LiDAR from a monocular camera image. In this work, we introduce LiFi (LiDAR From images), a dedicated framework for generating visually and geometrically aligned LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process through two complementary branches: geometry and semantics. The geometry branch constructs scene features from images through a reverse sampling algorithm and an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder combined with DepthAnything3, whereas the semantic branch provides high-level semantic representations via a cross-view interaction module. We further introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy, which enhances the model's conditional generation capability while preserving the independent learning and collaborative controllability of the two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiFi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi.

items.title_en: MSC: Multi-Stage Caster-aware Control Framework with Uncertainty-Aware NMPC and RL-based Execution Layer
items.title_zh: MSC：具有不确定性感知NMPC与基于RL执行层的多阶段连铸机感知控制框架
items.abstract_en: Freely swiveling casters are widely adopted in industrial AMRs/SDVs for their mechanical simplicity and load capacity. However, caster misalignment during low-speed or high-curvature maneuvers induces strong contact nonlinearities, widening the planning-execution gap between commanded $(v, ω)$ and realized motion. Existing caster-aware strategies are highly sensitive to state-estimation reliability, causing unstable execution in uncertain transition regimes. To address this, we present Multi-Stage Caster-aware Control (MSC), a planning-execution integrated hierarchical framework featuring two core mechanisms. First, an uncertainty-aware NMPC (CU-MPC) dynamically schedules caster-aware costs and input regularization using predictive uncertainty to suppress overly aggressive maneuvers. Second, a reinforcement learning-based execution layer estimates and predicts caster states under partial observability, transforming high-level velocity commands into physically executable wheel speeds adapted to current contact conditions. Validations in Isaac Sim and real robots demonstrate that MSC offers a clear comparative advantage over existing decoupled compensation approaches by significantly improving caster-state estimation accuracy, minimizing misalignment, and enhancing tracking robustness in caster-sensitive maneuvers.

items.title_en: All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking
items.title_zh: All-St3R SLAM：具有像素级运动掩码的实时RGB动态SLAM
items.abstract_en: SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a core technology in autonomous systems that enables them to estimate their own position and build a map of unknown environments simultaneously. SLAM systems in dynamic environments are of great practical importance. However, existing dynamic SLAM approaches still have several limitations like over-removal and high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM framework that precisely removes moving objects at the pixel level without relying on predefined labels or segmentation models. Our system combines pixel motion predicted by ego-motion using DUSt3R with point tracking from All-Tracker, removing only actually moving pixels by analyzing discrepancies between the two motion sources. Unlike object-level masking methods, our approach eliminates only currently moving regions, allowing temporarily static parts to be utilized for tracking. Operating at approximately 10 FPS, the system achieves real-time performance on standard 30 FPS video streams by subsampling every 3 frames. Relying solely on RGB inputs, this significantly improves upon state-of-the-art dense dynamic SLAM approaches (0.5-3 FPS), presenting a highly practical solution.
items.comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Project Page: https://yellowon0103.github.io/all-st3r-slam/

items.title_en: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
items.title_zh: UniW(A)M：面向世界模型与世界-动作模型的统一专家混合框架
items.abstract_en: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.
items.comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 34 pages, 19 figures, 15 tables

items.title_en: Historical-Feature Residual Adaptation for Sequential Screening
items.title_zh: 面向顺序筛选的历史特征残差自适应
items.abstract_en: Sequential screening policies must use acquired feedback effectively under a fixed experiment budget. We study acquisition-time residual adaptation: a small ranking correction built from fixed historical features and anchored to base scores recorded before feedback is revealed. The interface accepts a history-conditioned scorer and a candidate feature table; its primary instantiation augments AssayFormer's ten-dimensional representation with 64 historical directions while retaining the pretrained model. In retrospective evaluation on 20 official-test screens from 15 recorded sources, a comparison fixed before target-outcome access increased source-macro fraction of hits recovered from 22.58% to 28.61%, exceeding all six prespecified comparators. A same-feature ordinary ranking head achieved 25.73%. Supplementary strong logistic, rank-fusion, and unprojected controls achieved 26.42%, 26.02%, and 26.78%, respectively. A separate model-independent pilot on 13 reused development screens reconstructs the features without AssayFormer assets. Across three seeds, residual adaptation improves random-forest hit recovery from 28.87% to 31.27%, while logistic recovery changes from 30.22% to 29.78%. The results show effective pretrained-policy adaptation and useful transfer to an independent nonlinear base, with gains that depend on the base model.

items.title_en: REFLEX: A Learned On-Board Reflex for Robust Autonomous Collision Recovery of Soft Quadrotors
items.title_zh: REFLEX：用于软体四旋翼鲁棒自主碰撞恢复的学习型机载反射
items.abstract_en: Collision-resilient airframes allow quadrotors to survive impacts, but do not ensure autonomous post-collision recovery. Innovation gating in stock onboard estimators often rejects valid external velocity measurements after high-speed impacts, compromising recovery. We present REFLEX, a collision-recovery flight mode that runs entirely on the flight controller, requiring neither contact sensors nor a companion computer. Its proprioceptive recurrent policy stabilizes the vehicle without position, velocity, heading, or altitude estimates. The translational estimate is reinitialized while REFLEX is active, and a trust gate checks estimator consistency before returning control to the stock autopilot. The policy is trained in simulation using proximal policy optimization, with episodes initialized from post-impact states measured in 47 real collisions. In hardware experiments, REFLEX recovered 19 of 22 wall impacts at 5.03 $\pm$ 0.09 m/s, compared with 1 of 14 for the matched stock autopilot. These included 15 consecutive recoveries in a single flight. A separate exploratory flight demonstrated two additional recoveries at 6.02 and 6.05 m/s within the same flight, exceeding the previously reported velocity for autonomous wall-collision recovery by 64%.

items.title_en: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
items.title_zh: 在具有近端KL正则化的离策略RLVR中实现词元级重要性采样
items.abstract_en: Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse. Token-wise importance weighting avoids multiplying likelihood ratios across a response but generally biases policy gradients. We prove that, under coverage and local expressiveness conditions, full future KL credit makes the exact proximal optimizer the update's unique stationary policy, even for mixtures of older policies, without full-response weights or a fitted critic. We further establish convergence of continuous-time tabular population updates under persistent coverage and time-varying behavior policies, and a finite-sample reward guarantee for linear logistic models under additional assumptions. These results motivate Proximal KL, a practical off-policy RLVR method that separates the proximal reference from the sampling policy and replaces PPO clipping with bounded future KL credit. Across all seven matched off-policy comparisons on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, spanning two learning rates, response reuse, and rollout staleness, Proximal KL outperforms GRPO in micro-averaged accuracy over eight math benchmarks by up to 2.58%. A separate on-policy comparison yields comparable aggregate accuracy. In periodic-refresh experiments, Proximal KL avoids the collapses observed in PG and CISPO, exceeds GRPO's training accuracy, and reaches higher accuracy in fewer policy updates. Ablations show that token-wise correction outperforms sequence-level and unweighted controls. With token-wise correction retained, future KL feedback reduces sensitivity to the tested baseline perturbation relative to PPO clipping. A finite future horizon improves AIME24 mean@16 and pass@16 over the full tail, while fixed-policy measurements show that truncation reduces correction variance over the tested horizons.
